gui.essentialcraft5.magical_hopper.filte.en: With a filter here, the hopper only collects what the filter lets through
gui.essentialcraft5.magical_hopper.filte.zh: 放了过滤器以后，只收过滤器放行的东西

gui.essentialcraft5.magical_hopper.owner.en: This hopper wasn't placed by a player, so it moves nothing
gui.essentialcraft5.magical_hopper.owner.zh: 这个漏斗不是玩家放下的，不会搬东西

gui.essentialcraft5.magical_hopper.owner.en: Break it and place it again
gui.essentialcraft5.magical_hopper.owner.zh: 挖下来重新放一次就好

gui.essentialcraft5.magical_hopper.owner.en: Whoever placed it is offline, so it has paused
gui.essentialcraft5.magical_hopper.owner.zh: 放下它的人不在线，暂停搬运

gui.essentialcraft5.magical_hopper.owner.en: It carries on once they are back online
gui.essentialcraft5.magical_hopper.owner.zh: 那个人上线后自动恢复

gui.essentialcraft5.magical_hopper.redst.en: It stops while it gets a redstone signal and carries on as soon as the signal is gone
gui.essentialcraft5.magical_hopper.redst.zh: 有红石信号时停工，信号撤掉马上接着干

gui.essentialcraft5.filter.ghost_hint.1.en: Left-click holding an item: make it a sample (you keep the item)
gui.essentialcraft5.filter.ghost_hint.1.zh: 左键：拿着物品点这里，设成样本（东西还在你手上）

gui.essentialcraft5.filter.ghost_hint.2.en: Right-click: clear it. Shift-clicking an item in your inventory also works
gui.essentialcraft5.filter.ghost_hint.2.zh: 右键：清空。也可以 Shift 点背包里的东西

tooltip.essentialcraft5.filter.whitelist.en: Whitelist: only lets through items matching a sample
tooltip.essentialcraft5.filter.whitelist.zh: 白名单：只放行和样本一样的物品

tooltip.essentialcraft5.filter.blacklist.en: Blacklist: lets through everything except the samples
tooltip.essentialcraft5.filter.blacklist.zh: 黑名单：放行样本以外的一切

tooltip.essentialcraft5.filter.empty.whi.en: No samples yet, so it lets nothing through
tooltip.essentialcraft5.filter.empty.whi.zh: 还没有样本，现在什么都不放行

tooltip.essentialcraft5.filter.empty.bla.en: No samples yet, so it lets everything through
tooltip.essentialcraft5.filter.empty.bla.zh: 还没有样本，现在什么都放行

tooltip.essentialcraft5.filter.shift.en: Hold Shift to list the samples
tooltip.essentialcraft5.filter.shift.zh: 按住 Shift 查看样本

tooltip.essentialcraft5.filter.use.en: Right-click to set the samples; samples are not used up
tooltip.essentialcraft5.filter.use.zh: 右键设置样本，样本不会被消耗

gui.essentialcraft5.filter.ignore_damage.en: Worn and fresh items count as the same
Items with different durability don't count as the same

gui.essentialcraft5.filter.ignore_nbt.on.en: Only the kind of item matters: enchantments, names and contents are ignored
gui.essentialcraft5.filter.ignore_nbt.on.zh: 只看是哪种物品，附魔、名字、里面装的东西都不管

gui.essentialcraft5.filter.ignore_nbt.of.en: Enchantments, names and contents have to match too
gui.essentialcraft5.filter.ignore_nbt.of.zh: 附魔、名字、里面装的东西也要一样

gui.essentialcraft5.filter.match_tags.on.en: Each sample matches by its chosen tag (marked #); scroll over a sample to pick another
gui.essentialcraft5.filter.match_tags.on.zh: 每格按选中的标签比（格子上带 #），鼠标指着样本滚轮换标签

gui.essentialcraft5.filter.match_tags.of.en: Each sample only matches that exact item

gui.essentialcraft5.filter.sample_scroll.en: Scroll to pick another tag (%s to choose from)
gui.essentialcraft5.filter.sample_scroll.zh: 滚轮换标签（可选 %s 个）

gui.essentialcraft5.filter.sample_no_tag.en: This item has no tags, so it only matches itself
gui.essentialcraft5.filter.sample_no_tag.zh: 这件物品没有标签，只能按物品比
